subject: Civic Education
competence: Adapts to the democratic features seen in the family and in school
unique_learning_outcome: Names the democratic features in a family.
Explains how the democratic features in a family help its wellbeing.
Expresses the importance of developing features of a democratic life as a member of a family.
Describes the democratic features in a school.
Explains the importance of working in the school society adapting the democratic values.
the_entrance: The concept of democratic features in family and school will be introduced through a real-life scenario.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of democratic features in family and school through a real-life scenario.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will take notes and ask questions.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Formative assessment checks during this step

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student practical group activities from TIG.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Small group analysis, roleplay, or presentation tasks.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes.
post_activity: Concrete homework, workbook exercise, or mini-investigation.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
